title: How the Perfect American Hot Dog Is Made From Start to Finish!

segments.description: Medium establishing shot of a chef preparing hot dog buns, sausages, and condiment stations in a professional kitchen [[00:01](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mEIMltirg7w&t=1)].
Close-up action shot of sausages sizzling and getting perfect grill marks on a hot flat-top grill [[00:10](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mEIMltirg7w&t=10)].
Medium action shot of the chef pressing open hot dog buns onto the hot grill to toast them [[00:28](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mEIMltirg7w&t=28)].
Close-up shot of chopped onions and sweet relish being organized into prep containers [[00:39](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mEIMltirg7w&t=39)].

Medium close-up shot of assembling the hot dog by placing the grilled sausage into the toasted bun and adding mustard, ketchup, onions, and relish [[00:50](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mEIMltirg7w&t=50)].
Wide tabletop shot displaying the finished classic American hot dog served alongside crispy french fries on a red checkered tray [[01:10](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mEIMltirg7w&t=70)].
